At completion, the dish is promptly resealed and reweighed; spilled contents, a broken seal or an invalid exposure period require a replacement test.

The mass gain, test area and elapsed time are used to calculate the emission rate. This is a surface emission measurement under the test conditions, not a measurement of all water throughout the slab.

sections.title: Use the result for the specified floor system

The receiving layer and the original are watched during treatment. Movement of ink or color is a reason to stop or change the treatment, even after preliminary testing. Suction does not make every pigment insoluble, and treatment may deliberately leave some discoloration to preserve original media.

Additional grout encloses the bar with the required coverage, leaving room for the specified joint finish. The embedded reinforcement extends into sound masonry on each side so the repair can transfer load across the damaged area. A short bar sitting in a shallow cosmetic smear cannot perform that function.
